description.fun: Nihilego is a glassy, jellyfish-like Ultra Beast from the Ultra Deep Sea that latches onto a host's head and injects a neurotoxin. It doesn't control the host directly; instead it pushes their abilities to the extreme and strips away their inhibitions, so they fight to protect it. It shows little emotion or will, yet it's sometimes seen behaving like a young girl.
description.guide: Nihilego is a Rock- and Poison-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB-01 Symbiont, that resembles a jellyfish made of glass. It is a parasite that attaches to a host's head and drives its abilities to extremes. It comes from a world called the Ultra Deep Sea.
description.tagline: A glass jellyfish parasite that unleashes its host's full power
